Reproduce the site复现站点#

A clean checkout builds from committed research artifacts. Refreshing the evidence is a separate, explicit operation.干净 checkout 从已提交研究产物构建站点。刷新证据是独立、显式的操作。

bashBuild & preview
npm ci
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build

# Serve the generated site without a backend
python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory site

# React development server with hot updates
npm run dev
Refresh the fixed research snapshot刷新固定研究快照
bashOffline evidence enrichment
# Requires the archived extracted package and the local OSS repository.
# Ordinary builds do not need either source directory.
npm run research -- --snapshot /path/to/extracted-app --repo /path/to/codex --ref ddea03ad049142943bdbf13e937b1d67e8c1ba0c

npm run build

What remains open仍然未决的部分#

Runtime depth运行时深度

Scheduled, Pull requests, Security and Explore were captured, not walked end to end. Side-chat sending was not exercised.定时任务、拉取请求、安全与探索已有截图，但未端到端走查。侧聊发送尚未驱动。

Version equivalence版本等价性

The reference protocol and archived desktop package are independent sources. Matching names does not establish a matching binary build.参考协议与归档桌面包属于独立来源，同名不证明二进制构建一致。

Dynamic behavior动态行为

Dynamic expressions, minified aliases and server-provided configuration may escape a static inventory.动态表达式、压缩别名和服务端配置可能超出静态索引范围。

Capture provenance截图溯源

Settings have a matching recapture receipt. Other frames preserve the archived evidence without inventing missing receipts.设置截图具有匹配的 recapture 回执，其他画面保留归档证据，不补造缺失回执。

Rust corelayer · Execution boundaryCloud serviceslayer · Execution boundaryElectron shelllayer · Execution boundaryConversationscontext · A thread is the durable unit; turns and items describe work within it. Local and hosted conversations have different execution paths.Workspacecontext · Review, terminal, files, browser and side chat live alongside an active conversation. A panel is a UI surface, not an executor.Desktop integrationcontext · Window orchestration and native bridges connect the web-rendered interface to the operating system and subprocesses.Hosted workcontext · Tasks, agents and schedules have cloud-facing interfaces in the bundle. A captured destination does not prove its full workflow was exercised.Configuration & identitycontext · Settings combines protocol configuration, account services and OS permissions. Trace each setting to its own boundary.Thread lifecyclecapability · The protocol defines thread, turn and item operations. Conversation service paths are grouped alongside them as an analytical comparison, not proof that local threads depend on those paths.Approval and permission gatescapability · Core-to-client requests include approvals, user input and attestation. The direction identifies the party expected to answer; it does not establish which UI was displayed.Command executioncapability · Command and process operations are declared by the core. Platform-specific or absent bundle literals remain visible in the inventory.Filesystem and searchcapability · Core filesystem operations, cloud file services and the desktop file picker address different parts of file handling.MCP, skills, plugins, hookscapability · Skills, plugins, MCP and connectors span multiple interfaces. Their shared purpose is a domain grouping, not a single execution chain.Account, auth, entitlementcapability · The core has account and authentication methods; the bundle also contains hosted identity, workspace and billing services.
